evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: To cope with this problem, we first identify theoretically and empirically that shared expert, an always-activated component containing a small proportion of safety-critical neurons, can overcome the uncertainty of sparsely activated routing path and serve as a router-independent anchor to enhance global safety alignment.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: SEAL reduces attack success rate (ASR) by up to 60\%, at a capability cost of at most 1.4\% on a five-benchmark average.
